kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستمرئ (form X)
# نَسْتَمْرِئُ (nastamriʔu) /nas.tam.ri.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْرَأَ (istamraʔa)
# نَسْتَمْرِئَ (nastamriʔa) /nas.tam.ri.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَمْرَأَ (istamraʔa)
# نَسْتَمْرِئْ (nastamriʔ) /nas.tam.riʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَمْرَأَ (istamraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
